1.consolidated_definition: med. Médico, enfermero, etc. Especialista que trabaja en el cuidado y tratamiento de los enfermos, heridos, incapacitados, etc. El inglés actúa de elemento difusor. Calco de estructura, usual. También determinará si el cliente, por sus factores de riesgo, necesita ser referido a otro profesional de la salud como un terapista, nutricionista o especialista en el campo de la medicina” (El Nuevo Día, 12-11-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Medical professional, such as a doctor or nurse, who specializes in the care and treatment of patients, including those who are ill, injured, or disabled. The English language serves as a disseminator of information. A calque of structure, commonly used. It will also determine if the client, due to their risk factors, needs to be referred to another healthcare professional, such as a therapist, nutritionist, or specialist in the field of medicine.
